newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle trade quiet - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle trade quiet - USDA.

text.p: Steers and heifers were not tested on a live basis and not well established on a dressed basis, compared with Friday's close, USDA said.
